purpose: Confirm Mistral Medium 3 and Llama 4 Maverick can drive both agentic harnesses, which was previously untested. Gemini 2.5 Flash included as a control.

toolkit_versions.note: repo's register_backend seam (glean.agent_toolkit.tools._transport) and tool names (glean_search, glean_read_document) match this version

extra_dependency_found.why: litellm's Vertex partner route imports `vertexai`; without it every Mistral/Llama call fails with a misleading BadRequestError rather than an import error

adk_loop_glean_real_tool_specs.description: Glean's own tool specs via as_adk_tool(), canned backend behind glean_search / glean_read_document, so the toolkit's real schemas and ToolResult envelope are exercised unchanged

known_quirks.llama-4-maverick: Intermittently emits a textual pseudo tool call containing raw chat-template markers (e.g. '<|header_start|>assistant<|header_end|>\n\nglean_read_document(document_id="dsid_001")') before issuing the real structured call. Recovered in every observed case, but answers may carry template noise, and a non-recovering turn would yield an answer with no document_ids. The matrix script's smoke step checks for exactly that.

still_not_verified: A full 30-question run: needs the EnterpriseRAG-Bench corpus and the embedding cache, neither of which is present in this repo (it is a partial extract).
Multi-turn behaviour over hard questions where the agent must re-search several times.
Whether either partner model's answer quality is comparable - that is what the matrix run measures.
